general.descriptionTextModule: View and manage the webhooks of users, integrations and apps

list.tooltipAppWebhookNotDeletable: This webhook belongs to an app.
list.tooltipAppInactive: The app of this webhook is inactive, so the webhook is not sent.
list.messageDeleteError: The webhook could not be deleted.
list.emptyStateDescription: Webhooks created through the API or registered by apps are shown here.
list.loadErrorHeadline: The webhooks could not be loaded
list.loadErrorDescription: Reload the page to try again.

secret.title: Signing secret of "{name}"
secret.description: Each delivery gets a shopware-shop-signature header with the HMAC-SHA256 of the request body, made with this secret. The receiver uses it to check that the request came from this shop. Saving replaces the current secret right away, so the receiver has to be updated with the new one.
secret.placeholderSecret: Enter the receiver's secret or generate one
secret.hintShownOnce: Copy the secret before you save. It can't be shown again.
secret.messageSaveSuccess: The signing secret of "{name}" has been saved.
secret.messageSaveError: The signing secret of "{name}" could not be saved.
secret.errorTooLong: The secret can have at most {max} characters.

deliveries.title: Deliveries of "{name}"
deliveries.emptyStateDescription: Deliveries show up here once the event happens.
deliveries.loadErrorHeadline: The deliveries could not be loaded
deliveries.loadErrorDescription: Close the deliveries and open them again to retry.
